scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized $76 charge on her account and requesting a potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Aaliyah Washington and I'm 45. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello Aaliyah, I can certainly help you look into that charge. To start, could you please provide your account number and the zip code associated with your billing address?
Sure, my account number is 88492011 and I live in 30303.
Thank you. Just to be absolutely sure, can you also confirm the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?
Perfect, thanks. I see the charge here for $76 from 'Global Tech Services'. Does that name ring a bell at all?
No, I've never heard of them. I definitely didn't buy anything from a place with that name.

Understood. Per our standard terms regarding unauthorized transactions, I am unable to immediately reverse this charge as it requires a formal investigation by our fraud department. I'm going to go ahead and open a dispute case for you now.
Okay, that sounds like the right thing to do. How long does that usually take?

The process is typically completed within 5 to 7 business days. I've officially opened the dispute case, number 99283-X, and you'll receive an email confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

escalation_reason: The agent determined the unrecognized charge required a formal fraud investigation, which falls outside of tier-1 immediate resolution capabilities.

judge_scores.justification: The agent verified the customer's identity with an appropriate level of rigor and efficiently gathered necessary details without redundant questions. Furthermore, the agent correctly escalated the unrecognized charge for a formal fraud investigation, referencing standard terms regarding unauthorized transactions and providing a concrete case number.
